turns.prompt_text: I don't know if you can see my location but I'm at Iowa State and I'm looking to park here but I'm not sure if parking's I guess free or available until 5:00 or 5:30 p.m.
turns.response_html: At Iowa State, most general staff and student parking lots become free and available without a permit starting at 5:30 p.m. on weekdays. If you arrive before then, you will need to use metered spots or pay-by-stall lots, as permit enforcement is active until 5:30 p.m.
